entities.summary: The Ordinance of Alsnö or Statute of Alsnö was an act by king Magnus Ladulås of Sweden, issued at Alsnö hus in 1279, giving exemption from land taxation to those nobles who committed to produce a heavy cavalryman to the king's service:Because it is proper that those who support us with advice and help should have more honor we give to our men and those of our brother Bengt, and all their stewards and peasants and all on their estates, freedom from royal taxes, so also all the archbishop's men and all the bishop's men.
